svg.title: KaizenFlow — detailed specify, prove, and review workflow
svg.desc: Six stages: Specify, Build, Review, Fix, Merge, Finish. Three depths with a proof level each, conditional second review, exact-head merge, stop conditions, reviewer contract, and retrospective. Cards within a stage describe work or alternatives, not separate agent handoffs. Existing PRs skip Build. Every stop reaches Finish.
svg.text: KaizenFlow
Spec and proof first · one context builds and fixes · fresh review by depth · one script merges · a lesson on every exit
01 SPECIFY
Spend effort on the spec and the proof, not on review.
